title: cssunminifier makes dist/instantsearch.css breaks all css if minified

comments.body:
Thanks a lot for this issue! If you see any cli tool we can replace this with, that would be great. 

Another option might be to have minified css both in .min.css and .css
@cmalard what's the use case of using `cssunminifier`?

@bobylito We are using `cssunminifier` to provide `instantsearch.css` for the build.

Webpack -> output instantsearch.min.css -> cssunminifier -> output instantsearch.css
For my use case, I don't need it at all. If I need to see instantsearch's css, I do it with devtools wich beautify it anyway.
